purpose: A shared named icon adapter for consistent stroke-based interface artwork.
behaviorProvider: Shared Hugeicons SVG factory; individual named icon exports use the same wrapper.

component: Use the shared createIcon wrapper for the exported glyphs. Default size and stroke width come from iconography runtime tokens; caller values may override them.
Hide an icon from assistive technology unless aria-label or aria-labelledby is supplied, and default SVG focusable to false. Preserve forwarded SVG refs/properties.
host: Use the surrounding button/link label for action semantics; icons alone do not create interactive controls.
Supply a meaningful accessible name for informative standalone glyphs. Choose approved group dimensions and do not encode meaning only through shape or color.

requirements.statement: Use the shared createIcon wrapper for the exported glyphs. Default size and stroke width come from iconography runtime tokens; caller values may override them.

When style.stroke is a url paint reference, apply it to primary and secondary icon colors so the shared AI gradient marker can use the same glyph engine.
Use the surrounding button/link label for action semantics; icons alone do not create interactive controls.
Supply a meaningful accessible name for informative standalone glyphs. Choose approved group dimensions and do not encode meaning only through shape or color.

Use iconography group tokens for owned presentation, preserve genuine nested component ownership, and verify the same geometry across Fundamental and Fundamental Floating in light/dark. Keep the documented semantics and state model when composing or extending this family.

limitations: Iconography is a family-level contract for shared wrapping behavior; it does not certify each glyph as an unambiguous semantic symbol.
Authored source coverage is separate from executed interaction, visual, accessibility and consumer-package evidence.
